title: mesh-bus-egress-udp
description: UDP egress plugin configuration and behavior. Each DatagramSession binds one persistent UdpSocket; send_to fires immediately without waiting for a response. split() returns UdpDatagramSendHalf (fire-and-forget) and UdpDatagramRecvHalf (continuous recv_from loop) backed by a shared Arc<UdpSocket>.

socket_recv_buffer_bytes.description: Optional SO_RCVBUF size in bytes for UDP egress sockets.

socket_send_buffer_bytes.description: Optional SO_SNDBUF size in bytes for UDP egress sockets.

datagram_boundary.description: Each DatagramSession::send_to call is emitted as exactly one UDP datagram; payload boundaries are not coalesced or split by this adapter.

fixed_target_mode.description: Optional service-sink mode: send_to target is ignored for the socket send and the configured fixed endpoint is used instead.
